ev.q: CDC recommends that Zika virus rRT-PCR be performed on urine collected <14 days after onset of symptoms in patients with suspected Zika virus disease.

public_health_question.v: Should Zika virus rRT-PCR testing be performed on urine specimens, and within what interval after symptom onset?

ev.q: On the basis of the newly available data, CDC recommends that Zika virus rRT-PCR be performed on urine collected <14 days after onset of symptoms

notes: A guidance statement; the only quantitative content is a cited finding that Zika RNA is detectable in urine for at least 2 weeks, so 'limited' is an alternative reading. The prepass diagnostic-accuracy cue is a false hit: sensitivity is named only as a topic for future investigation.
